description: This Dart source file defines the AgentService class which implements a core AI agent loop, handling message exchanges, tool execution, and step management for a React-based system. It also includes exception handling and tool setup such as file reading/writing, time retrieval, and mathematical evaluation.

classes.name: AgentException
classes.description: Custom exception class for agent error handling with specific error types and messages.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: Main class implementing the AI agent loop with message processing, tool execution, and state management.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the agent's internal state, timeline, message history, and running flag.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Executes the agent loop for a given user input, managing message exchange and tool invocation.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Adds a new step of a specific type (thought, action, observation, final_answer) to the agent's step list.

methods.name: _setupTools
methods.description: Initializes available tools with their corresponding actions, such as file operations, time retrieval, and calculations.

methods.name: _evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression string securely.

methods.name: _pF
methods.description: Parses factors in expressions, including parentheses and unary minus.

methods.name: _executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes a specified tool action.

methods.name: _parseAction
methods.description: Parses the action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: _parseArguments
methods.description: Parses comma-separated arguments from an action string.

methods.name: _extractContent
methods.description: Extracts content within specific XML tags from a string.

methods.name: _generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the initial system prompt string that guides the agent's response format.
